name: location
description: Functional Quest Engineering location. Move it to the logical center of the building or district. Keep its stable name unchanged.

name: interaction_region
description: Clickable area for a functional location. Move and resize it visually around the building or yard.

name: camera_anchor
description: Camera focus point for a location. Move this point visually instead of editing camera coordinates in code.

name: overview_bounds
description: Rectangle fitted by Town camera mode. Resize it around the functional town, excluding marker staging areas.

name: workstation
description: Generic factual Member work position. It is presentation metadata and is never tied to Step names or engineering semantics.

name: member_home
description: Possible idle or gathering position for a factual Member. Move the point; never author Member identity here.

name: crew_spawn
description: Point where active crew enter the town. The stable object name identifies the entrance; it is never tied to a Member.

name: crew_route
description: Polyline tracing a visibly safe crew walking route. Route vertices connect only when they coincide within the documented tolerance.

name: crew_activity
description: Point or rectangle for presentation-only crew activity. It does not change Runtime or Tactic semantics.

name: island_socket
description: Authored attachment point between a Project-island base and an expansion. Matching edge/category and opposite orientation compose by transform.

name: ambient_zone
description: Moveable and resizable area for presentation-only ambient activity.

name: animal_route
description: Simple presentation-only animal polyline. Move its points to edit the route; no pathfinding is implied.

name: status_anchor
description: Preferred point for a building-level runtime or lifecycle status glyph.

name: reserved_site
description: Reserved future presentation area. It has no runtime interaction or accessible control.

name: static_sprite
description: Freestanding visual object placed below runtime Members.

name: authoring_note
description: Editor-only guidance. Authoring Notes are ignored by Quest Engineering runtime.
